title: CSOAI reproducibility manifest v0
description: One-command stranger re-run pack. Folds trace_hash + harness_version + seed + dataset_hash + grader_version. Any field not honestly known is the literal string UNCHECKABLE and is never invented. A card MAY reference repro_manifest_sha256; that reference never upgrades an UNCHECKABLE field. Not a GSPC axis, not a certificate, does not write the board.

fields.description: Each value is a real value or the literal 'UNCHECKABLE'.
